Terminal-Lego-15k: Docker-Verified Terminal Agent Tasks from Real StackOverflow Issues
	

Project Page · Code · Paper · Models
Terminal-Lego-15k is a large-scale collection of Docker-verified, Terminal-Bench-style agentic tasks built from real StackOverflow technical issues. Each task is constructed through the Terminal-Lego pipeline: StackOverflow questions are filtered, converted via cascaded LLM generation, and retained only after Docker round-trip verification.
